text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: This shall be the ritual for the leprous person at the time of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest;
text_cn: “关于癞病人取洁之日应守的法律如下：应引他去见司祭，

text_en: the priest shall go out of the camp, and the priest shall make an examination. If the disease is healed in the leprous person,
text_cn: 司祭应到营外查看，如见癞病人的病症痊愈了，

text_en: the priest shall command that two living clean birds and cedarwood and crimson yarn and hyssop be brought for the one who is to be cleansed.
text_cn: 就吩咐人为那取洁者，拿两只洁净的活鸟、香柏木、朱红线和牛膝草来；

text_en: The priest shall command that one of the birds be slaughtered over fresh water in an earthen vessel.
text_cn: 然后吩咐人在盛着活水的陶器上，宰杀一只鸟。

text_en: He shall take the living bird with the cedarwood and the crimson yarn and the hyssop, and dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the fresh water.
text_cn: 司祭拿另一只活鸟同香柏木、朱红线和牛膝草，连活鸟一起浸在杀于活水上的鸟血内，

text_en: He shall sprinkle it seven times upon the one who is to be cleansed of the leprous disease; then he shall pronounce him clean, and he shall let the living bird go into the open field.
text_cn: 向那取洁的癞病人洒血七次，使他洁净；然后放那只活鸟飞向田野，

text_en: The one who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water, and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall live outside his tent seven days.
text_cn: 那取洁的人洗涤自己的衣服，剃去身上所有的毛，用水洗澡，这样就算洁净了。此后，他方可进入营内，但仍应在自己帐幕外居住七天。

text_en: On the seventh day he shall shave all his hair: of head, beard, eyebrows; he shall shave all his hair. Then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe his body in water, and he shall be clean.
text_cn: 到了第七天，他应剃去身上所有的毛：头发、胡须和眉毛；身上所有的毛都应剃去，然后洗涤衣服，用水洗身，就算完全洁净了。

text_en: On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb in its first year without blemish, and a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of choice flour mixed with oil, and one log of oil.
text_cn: 到第八天，他应带两只无瑕的公羔羊，一只一岁的无瑕母羔羊，作素祭用的十分之三‘厄法’油调的细面，和一‘罗格’油。

text_en: The priest who cleanses shall set the person to be cleansed, along with these things, before the Lord , at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 行取洁礼的司祭，应叫取洁的人拿着这一切，站在会幕门口，上主面前。

text_en: The priest shall take one of the lambs, and offer it as a guilt offering, along with the log of oil, and raise them as an elevation offering before the Lord .
text_cn: 司祭取一只公羔羊同一‘罗格’油，一起献作赎过祭，在上主前行奉献的摇礼。

text_en: He shall slaughter the lamb in the place where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered in the holy place; for the guilt offering, like the sin offering, belongs to the priest: it is most holy.
text_cn: 然后在宰杀赎罪祭和全燔祭牺牲的圣地方，宰杀这只公羔羊，因为赎过祭牺牲，如赎罪祭牺牲一样，应归司祭：这是至圣之物。

text_en: The priest shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of the right hand, and on the big toe of the right foot.
text_cn: 司祭取些赎过祭牺牲的血， 抹在取洁者的右耳垂，右手拇指和右脚大趾上；

text_en: The priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour it into the palm of his own left hand,
text_cn: 再由那一‘罗格’油中，取些油倒在自己的左手掌中，

text_en: and dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand and sprinkle some oil with his finger seven times before the Lord .
text_cn: 将自己的一个右手指，浸在左手掌中的油内，用手指在上主前洒油七次；

text_en: Some of the oil that remains in his hand the priest shall put on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of the right hand, and on the big toe of the right foot, on top of the blood of the guilt offering.
text_cn: 然后将掌中剩下的油，抹在取洁者的右耳垂，右手拇指和右脚大趾上，即在抹赎过祭牺牲血的地方。

text_en: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed. Then the priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the Lord :
text_cn: 以后将掌中剩下的油，都抹在取洁者的头上：如此司祭在上主面前为那人行了赎罪礼。

text_en: the priest shall offer the sin offering, to make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness. Afterward he shall slaughter the burnt offering;
text_cn: 此后，司祭应奉献赎罪祭，为取洁者赎罪除去不洁；最后应宰杀全燔祭牺牲，

text_en: and the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. Thus the priest shall make atonement on his behalf and he shall be clean.
text_cn: 在祭坛上奉献全燔祭和素祭。司祭这样为他行了赎罪礼，他就洁净了。

text_en: But if he is poor and cannot afford so much, he shall take one male lamb for a guilt offering to be elevated, to make atonement on his behalf, and one-tenth of an ephah of choice flour mixed with oil for a grain offering and a log of oil;
text_cn: 但是，如果他贫穷，手中财力不足，可拿一只公羔羊作赎过祭，行摇礼为他赎罪；十分之一‘厄法’油调的细面作素祭，一‘罗格’油，

text_en: also two turtledoves or two pigeons, such as he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.
text_cn: 和按财力所能备办的两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽：一只作赎罪祭，一只作全燔祭。

text_en: On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, before the Lord ;
text_cn: 他应在第八天，将这一切送交司祭，在会幕门口于上主面前为自己取洁。

text_en: and the priest shall take the lamb of the guilt offering and the log of oil, and the priest shall raise them as an elevation offering before the Lord .
text_cn: 司祭便取那只作赎过祭的公羔羊和一‘罗格’油，在上主面前行奉献的摇礼；

text_en: The priest shall slaughter the lamb of the guilt offering and shall take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of the right hand, and on the big toe of the right foot.
text_cn: 然后宰杀作赎过祭的公羔羊，取些赎过祭牺牲的血，抹在取洁者的右耳垂，右手拇指和右脚大趾上；

text_en: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand,
text_cn: 然后倒些油在自己左手掌中，

text_en: and shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord .
text_cn: 用一只右手指蘸些左手掌中的油，在上主面前洒七次；

text_en: The priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of the right hand, and the big toe of the right foot, where the blood of the guilt offering was placed.
text_cn: 再将掌中的油抹在取洁者的右耳垂，右手拇指和右脚大趾上，即在抹赎过祭牺牲血的地方；

text_en: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement on his behalf before the Lord .
text_cn: 掌中还有的剩下的油，都抹在取洁者的头上，为他在上主面前行赎罪礼。

text_en: And he shall offer, of the turtledoves or pigeons such as he can afford,
text_cn: 取洁的人按自己财力，所能备办的两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，

text_en: one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, along with a grain offering; and the priest shall make atonement before the Lord on behalf of the one being cleansed.
text_cn: 按他的财力所能献的，其中一只献作赎罪祭，一只献作全燔祭，同素祭一起献上。司祭应这样为取洁的人在上主面前行赎罪礼。

text_en: This is the ritual for the one who has a leprous disease, who cannot afford the offerings for his cleansing.
text_cn: 这是关于身患癞病而财力不足备办取洁祭品者的法律。”

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: When you come into the land of Canaan, which I give you for a possession, and I put a leprous disease in a house in the land of your possession,
text_cn: “当你们进入了我赐给你们作产业的客纳罕地，在你们占有的地方，我令房屋发生癞病迹象时，

text_en: the owner of the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, “There seems to me to be some sort of disease in my house. ”
text_cn: 房主就应去告诉司祭说：我看在我房屋内出现了一些相似癞病的斑痕。

text_en: The priest shall command that they empty the house before the priest goes to examine the disease, or all that is in the house will become unclean; and afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.
text_cn: 在司祭进去查看斑痕以前，应吩咐人先搬空房屋，免得屋内的一切染上不洁；然后司祭进去查看房屋。

text_en: He shall examine the disease; if the disease is in the walls of the house with greenish or reddish spots, and if it appears to be deeper than the surface,
text_cn: 司祭查看斑痕时，如见屋内墙上的斑痕带些发绿或发红的小孔，似乎深过墙皮，

text_en: the priest shall go outside to the door of the house and shut up the house seven days.
text_cn: 就应由屋内出来，到房门口，将房屋封锁七天。

text_en: The priest shall come again on the seventh day and make an inspection; if the disease has spread in the walls of the house,
text_cn: 到第七天，司祭再来查看，如见斑痕在屋内墙上蔓延开了，

text_en: the priest shall command that the stones in which the disease appears be taken out and thrown into an unclean place outside the city.
text_cn: 就应命人拔出有斑痕的石头，丢在城外不洁的地方；

text_en: He shall have the inside of the house scraped thoroughly, and the plaster that is scraped off shall be dumped in an unclean place outside the city.
text_cn: 且叫人刮净屋内四周，将刮下的灰土，倒在城外不洁的地方，

text_en: They shall take other stones and put them in the place of those stones, and take other plaster and plaster the house.
text_cn: 再拿别的石头嵌进拔出的石头处，拿别的灰土，粉刷房屋。

text_en: If the disease breaks out again in the house, after he has taken out the stones and scraped the house and plastered it,
text_cn: 在拔出石头，刮扫，粉刷房屋以后，如斑痕又在屋内出现，

text_en: the priest shall go and make inspection; if the disease has spread in the house, it is a spreading leprous disease in the house; it is unclean.
text_cn: 司祭还应来查看，如见斑痕在屋内蔓延开了，这就是房屋上的腐蚀性癞病；这房屋即是不洁的，

text_en: He shall have the house torn down, its stones and timber and all the plaster of the house, and taken outside the city to an unclean place.
text_cn: 应拆毁这座房屋；房屋的石头、木材和所有的灰土，都应运到城外不洁的地方。

text_en: All who enter the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening;
text_cn: 整个封锁日期内，如有人进入屋内，直到晚上成为不洁的；

text_en: and all who sleep in the house shall wash their clothes; and all who eat in the house shall wash their clothes.
text_cn: 如有人在这屋内睡觉，应洗涤自己的衣服；如有人在这屋内吃饭，亦应洗涤自己的衣服。

text_en: If the priest comes and makes an inspection, and the disease has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, the priest shall pronounce the house clean; the disease is healed.
text_cn: 但是，如果司祭来查看，见房屋刷新以后，斑痕在屋内没有蔓延，司祭就应声明房屋是洁净的，因为患处已好了。

text_en: For the cleansing of the house he shall take two birds, with cedarwood and crimson yarn and hyssop,
text_cn: 司祭应拿两只飞鸟、香柏木、朱红线和牛膝草来为房屋取洁；

text_en: and shall slaughter one of the birds over fresh water in an earthen vessel,
text_cn: 一只飞鸟，应在盛有活水的陶器上宰杀，

text_en: and shall take the cedarwood and the hyssop and the crimson yarn, along with the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
text_cn: 然后拿香柏木、牛膝草、朱红线和那只活鸟，一同浸在那已杀的鸟血及活水内，向房屋连洒七次。

text_en: Thus he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the fresh water, and with the living bird, and with the cedarwood and hyssop and crimson yarn;
text_cn: 用鸟血、活水、活鸟、香柏木、牛膝草、朱红线为房屋取洁以后，

text_en: and he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field; so he shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
text_cn: 司祭应放那只活鸟飞向城外的田野：他这样为房屋行取洁礼，房屋就洁净了。

text_en: This is the ritual for any leprous disease: for an itch,
text_cn: 这是关于各种癞病症象、癣(xuǎn)疥(jiè)、

text_en: for leprous diseases in clothing and houses,
text_cn: 衣癞、屋癞、

text_en: and for a swelling or an eruption or a spot,
text_cn: 肿瘤、疮疖（jiē）和斑痕，

text_en: to determine when it is unclean and when it is clean. This is the ritual for leprous diseases.
text_cn: 使人知道几时不洁，几时洁净的法律。这是关于癞病所定的法律。”
